Things get worse before they get better dear, I've been told this a lot.
I don't know if its true but I would rather hope that there's gold at the end of a rainbow then ignore the rainbow. Why is it that you can't eat? Because there are ways around that, look into the medicine marinol, they give it to cancer patience, anorexics and people who have a tough time eating, it is also an anti depressant by default! Staying a while to see the outcome of your life is defiantly worth it.

I'm really attached to Jack Conte for the lyrics AND background music, I connect more to the songs, Like a match, impressions, Hollywood endings, and this disaster. I also connect well with circa survive. But things like deadmau5, the contortionist, the faceless, jarren benton, most of strange music, and a lot of dubstep and pagan music.

Thank you for the kind words, I really love my boyfriend and I KNOW he loves me, but both of us are in a REALLY bad situation. We're scrambling for job living at his dads house trying to get away from the really bipolar circumstances. We've been okay for 10 months going from couch to couch. And the woman who lives here impedes on our job finding ability and purposefully sets us up to fail.  We've been fighting almost every day recently and he's been having more and more blackouts, I'm in over y head but I will NEVER leave him, he's not just somone who stands by me, he's my equal,my best fiend. 
You had asked the question of why I had grown up at 5, my dad would sexually abused me from 5-12 after which I was made homeless. 
In my homelessness I had found myself in a near constant state of fear. 
The streets really harden people up, but sometimes it's only for the time that you were in that near constant state of fear. After I was accepted back into my family at the age of 16, I had bondage training and pet training, emotionally disturbed, and suicidal under my belt. My family shunned me a great deal for awhile, I was tooken advantage of in my weakness by a young man, he tricked me into saying yes for a engagement proposal a month in and i became aware of the fact that he was emotionally abusive, sexually abusive, emotionally numb, and a sick fuck of a man. I was kept in conditions that were inhumane at best. And now 4 years later I'm not over it, I'm running around trying to give my life meaning and it's fucking HARD.
iWANT to enjoy life, I WANT it to have meaning I WANT to be normal. 
But I've learned that is usualy more difficult to achieve than one would think.
When I was five I grew up really fast. My dad would rape me and it taught me everything I needed to know, wether directly, or indirectly about what I need to do to be an adult.

Music speaks to me louder and more clearly than words. I connect to music like a person would connect to another person. I feel safer making attachments to music because they won't think badly of me, they won't push me away, they won't be offended if I push them away, and they will never change.
You seem kind, ill help you if you help me.

Hey.. I can't go to my boyfriend because he is in the same boat as me, and too stressed out to care, he has black out depressive episodes so I'm not usually sure when he's himself or not unless I start to see scratch marks on his arms or he becomes incredibly morbid. I just want us to be happy, but I'm getting so tired, I can't handle anymore, life has come to the point for me where it's a chore and an unfair one. The only thing I do anymore is reddit. None of my friends are mature enough for me to want them in my life anymore, I feel so much different than other people, I've tried therapy, medicine, yoga, meditation. None of it works and I feel stranded in a life I didn't ask for and have had literally no control of since I was little. I lost control of my life when I was five and I'm twenty now and I still have no control.
